note.text: Recorded native Claude 2.1.310 paid verification on Windows: permission. Curated from completed 2026-10-26 calls, with no additional agent calls. Curation replaces native session IDs, local paths and ISO timestamps with placeholders. Streamed tool JSON is reassembled for redaction and repartitioned into the original number of records only when values change; those chunk boundaries are synthetic. Control envelopes, turn content, tool input/result meaning, result accounting and event order are retained. ISO quota reset timestamps become placeholders and do not exercise timestamp parsing; synthetic telemetry fixtures cover that behavior.
